name: Artifact Search (deterministic catalog + hybrid lexical retrieval)
purpose: The Collective Agent's authoritative catalog + hybrid LEXICAL search substrate (D-0080 Wave 1, arch position 23). A stdlib-only Python worker (artifact_search.py) owns a SQLite database (sources / documents / document_versions / chunks / chunk_embeddings + FTS5) with full provenance. Ops: 'ingest' walks a root, content-hashes an inventory, detects new/changed/moved/deleted files, chunks Markdown structurally (headings/sections/code-fence-aware) with a generic-text fallback, indexes chunk text in SQLite FTS5, embeds new/changed chunks through a DETERMINISTIC MOCK embedding provider (the D-0077 embedding-provider seam; the real adapter #35 drops in unchanged at fold), reconciles changed/deleted with NO duplicate chunks, runs a DB integrity check, and emits a deterministic catalog_digest. 'search' (the retriever interface #37 consumes) returns ranked, provenance-complete hits {source_path, content_hash, chunk_id, span, section_path, score, snippet} in a DETERMINISTIC order (stable chunk_id tie-break); mode fts (SQLite FTS5) or exact (literal substring over chunk text + filename). 'embed' returns the embedding-provider envelope. 'integrity' runs PRAGMA integrity_check + catalog invariants. 'catalog' returns catalog_digest + counts. 'export-chunk-texts' / 'store-embeddings' are the fold drop-in (export ordered chunk texts -> real adapter -> store vectors by chunk_id). Determinism: chunk/document/version ids are content+path derived (repo-relative paths + byte spans) so identical corpus content yields an identical catalog_digest across runs AND machines; the SQLite file itself is NOT byte-reproducible. CPU-only, no model, no network -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance. Non-goals (NOT built): AST/call-graph/symbol index, summaries, episodes, failure memory, context compiler, UI, web search, real embeddings.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op ingest|search|embed|integrity|catalog|export-chunk-texts|store-embeddings (default search); -Query <string> (search); -Text <string> (embed single); -Source <label>; -Root <dir> (ingest); -DbPath <path> (default runtime/catalog/artifact_search.db); -Mode fts|exact (default fts); -K <int, default 10>; -Dim <int, default 64>; -Normalize:$true|$false (default true); -MaxFiles <int budget>; -MaxChunkChars <int, default 4000>; -EmbedProvider mock|none; -PythonPath <python>; -WorkerPath <artifact_search.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json {op, query, text, texts[], source, root, db, mode, k, dim, normalize, max_files, max_chunk_chars, embed_provider, include[], exclude[], exclude_dirs[], filters{source,type,path_prefix,content_hash}, chunk_ids[], vectors[][], provider_id, model_id, model_version, model_sha256, engine_build, python_path}>' (named params override matching keys). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: search: the query text (fts tokens AND-ed; exact = literal substring over chunk text + filename).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: embed: a single text (alternative to texts[]).

inputs.name: texts
inputs.description: embed: a batch of texts; vectors align 1:1 in EXACT input order.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: ingest: a stable source label (slugged to source_id; the logical corpus identity, machine-independent). search/filters: restrict to this source.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: ingest: the directory root to walk.

inputs.name: db
inputs.description: the SQLite catalog path (created by ingest; required to exist for other ops).

inputs.name: max_files
inputs.description: ingest: file budget (0 = no cap); a hit is surfaced as a warning + report.file_budget_hit.

inputs.name: max_chunk_chars
inputs.description: ingest: soft chunk size target (split at blank lines, never inside a code fence).

inputs.name: embed_provider
inputs.description: ingest: mock (deterministic hashed pseudo-vectors) | none (lexical only).

inputs.name: include
inputs.description: ingest: optional include globs on rel_path/filename (default: all text-like).

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: ingest: exclude globs on rel_path/filename (default: *.db etc.).

inputs.name: chunk_ids
inputs.description: store-embeddings: chunk ids aligned 1:1 with vectors[].

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.description: store-embeddings: externally-produced vectors (fold drop-in for the real adapter).

outputs.description: envelope.result = { op, result:<op payload>, worker, runtime_ms }. ingest -> { source_id, root, run_id, counts{seen,added,changed,deleted,unchanged,parse_failures,moved}, added[], changed[], deleted[], moved[{from,to}], parse_failures[{rel_path,reason,detail}], catalog_digest, integrity{ok,checks[]}, integrity_ok, counts_total, db }. search -> { query, mode, k, count, filters, results[{source_path, abs_path, content_hash, chunk_id, span{start,end}, section_path, heading, chunk_type, source, score, snippet, rank}], db }. embed -> { provider_id, model_id, model_version, model_sha256, engine_build, dim, normalized, count, vectors[[...]], input_status[{index,status,reason?}] }. integrity -> { ok, checks[{name,ok,detail}], counts, db }. catalog -> { db, digest, counts }. export-chunk-texts -> { count, chunks[{chunk_id, rel_path, content_hash, span, text}], db }. store-embeddings -> { stored, requested, skipped_unknown_chunk, provider_id, dim }.
